definitions.gloss: frog kick; the breaststroke leg motion
definitions.explanation: The characteristic leg movement of the breaststroke, in which the knees bend and the feet sweep outward and then together, resembling the kick of a frog.

examples.japanese: {蛙足|かえるあし}で{泳|およ}ぐ。
examples.english: To swim with a frog kick.

examples.japanese: {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎでは{蛙足|かえるあし}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: In the breaststroke you use a frog kick.

examples.japanese: {蛙足|かえるあし}のタイミングを{合|あ}わせると、{体|からだ}が{前|まえ}へよく{進|すす}む。
examples.english: When you time the frog kick right, your body glides forward well.

notes:
Compound of {蛙|かえる} (frog) + {足|あし} (legs). The leg action of the breaststroke ({平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ), where the feet draw up, sweep out, and snap together like a frog kicking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛙足|かえるあし}で{泳|およ}ぐ: to swim with a frog kick
- {蛙足|かえるあし}キック: frog kick

Mainly a swimming term; the motion is also called あおり{足|あし}.
